findings.title: Confirm ignores pending path and revert
findings.message: The confirm handler for "open" calls fileAction, which opens via openStudy with an empty path. A pending recent-study path (m.pendingStudyPath) is cleared or ignored, so choosing a recent file with unsaved changes and confirming discard opens the file chooser instead of the selected study. Also the new "revert" case is not handled in the switch, so the Revert to Saved button does nothing.
findings.suggestion: Capture path before clearing, and add cases: case "open": m.result(m.openStudy(path, true)); case "revert": m.result(m.openStudy(path, true)).

findings.title: Recent recorded on every completion
findings.message: recordRecent runs for every successful completion, including a failed-then-ok path or a cancelled result with empty Path. It also records the path before the open is validated. A bad recent entry could be persisted. Mostly harmless, but Revert completions also reorder the list.
findings.suggestion: Guard on r.Path != "" and only record for open/save actions.
